hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion first; coordinate and use online Martin calendar for hearings up to one hour; longer hearings requested by assistant email. proposed_orders.summary: Email Word orders with motion and cover letter identifying agreement/disagreement and complete service list. Profile generally says no advance order unless requested, but scheduling paragraph asks for motion/order before hearing; retain both.

remote_appearances.summary: Remote appearance requires written motion, service and emailed courtesy copy; court rules on request. Meeting ID alone is not permission. Detailed criminal deadlines not abstracted.
